backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing the D.K Home Theatre backend with screenings, seat plans, reservations, and user profile management, plus role-based access control (admin/user) using a MixinAuthorization pattern and automatic data migration on upgrades.
backend/migration.mo: Defines the stable actor state types and a migration function (currently identity) used during canister upgrades to transform old state to the current schema.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping the admin self-promotion 'Claim Admin Access' UI flow to its implementing files (AdminGuard.tsx and useQueries.ts) with confidence and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated JSON document containing one-to-two sentence summaries of every frontend source file, used as a build-planning reference.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining OKLCH CSS custom properties for light and dark themes covering background, foreground, card, border, chart, and sidebar color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point for the Vite/React app, mounting the React root div and loading main.tsx as an ES module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component managing top-level page state (browse/booking/admin), routing between Browse, BookingFlow, and AdminPanel pages inside a dark ThemeProvider with a Sonner Toaster.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminGuard: A route guard component that checks Internet Identity authentication and admin role, showing login prompts, a loading spinner, or a 'claim admin' flow before rendering protected admin children.
frontend/src/components/admin/Reservatio: Displays all reservations for a given screening with status badges and allows admins to confirm or cancel individual reservations via mutation hooks.
frontend/src/components/admin/ScreeningM: Admin panel component for managing screenings, providing CRUD operations (add, edit, delete) via dialogs and supporting URL list editing for poster images and trailer links.
frontend/src/components/admin/SeatPlanEd: React component for admins to create and manage seat plans for a screening, supporting adding/removing rows and seats, and toggling seat status with visual color coding.
frontend/src/components/AnimatedBackgrou: Decorative background component that renders 40 seeded-random cinema-themed emoji and symbol characters with varied candy colors and CSS keyframe animations.
frontend/src/components/BookingSummary.t: Post-booking confirmation component styled as a cinema ticket, displaying screening details, selected seat labels, customer info, and reservation ID with a gold-gradient header.
frontend/src/components/FoodMenuItem.tsx: Renders a single food menu item card with emoji, name, description, price, and increment/decrement quantity controls. Highlights the card when quantity is greater than zero.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Provides the top-level page layout with a sticky header containing the app logo, navigation links (Screenings, Admin), and an Internet Identity login/logout button.
frontend/src/components/MediaSection.tsx: Displays a movie's poster images in a scrollable gallery and renders trailer links as embedded YouTube/Vimeo iframes or fallback external links.
Form component that collects customer name and contact info, validates input, and submits a seat reservation for a given screening via the useMakeReservation mutation.
frontend/src/components/ScreeningList.ts: Fetches and displays all screenings as a responsive grid of cards with poster images, dates, and neon-colored borders; handles loading skeletons and empty/error states.
frontend/src/components/SeatIcon.tsx: Renders an individual cinema seat button with an SVG seat graphic and a label, applying different CSS classes based on the seat's status (available, selected, reserved, booked).
frontend/src/components/SeatMap.tsx: Renders an interactive cinema seat map for a given screening, grouping seats by row and displaying each seat's availability/selection status using SeatIcon components, with loading skeletons and error states.
frontend/src/components/TheaterBanner.ts: Displays a decorative hero banner for the theatre homepage with a blurred backdrop image, film strip borders, cinematic gradient overlays, and a premium badge with the theatre title.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status via a React context hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks for the backend actor, covering admin checks, user profiles, screenings, seat plans, and reservations with queries and mutations.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file defining a cinematic dark theme with custom design tokens (gold, red, theatre-specific colors), Tailwind layers, and utility classes for seat states and UI elements.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin panel page protected by AdminGuard, providing a two-column layout to manage screenings, seat plans, and reservations via tabbed sub-components.
frontend/src/pages/BillReceipt.tsx: Renders a styled booking confirmation receipt showing seat, food, GST, and total cost breakdown with a generated transaction ID and booking reference. Includes print-friendly layout and a 'Done' button.
frontend/src/pages/BookingFlow.tsx: Multi-step booking wizard managing transitions between seat selection, reservation form, food items, and bill receipt steps. Passes collected data (seats, customer info, food) through each step.
frontend/src/pages/Browse.tsx: Main browse page displaying an animated background, theatre banner, and a list of upcoming screenings for the user to select.
frontend/src/pages/FoodItems.tsx: Food and beverage selection page with a hardcoded menu, quantity controls per item, and a running total before proceeding to the receipt or skipping.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom theatre-themed colors (gold, red, dark), fonts (Playfair Display, Fredoka One), shadows, and border radii using oklch color values.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking the app's name, existing features, pending admin-role feature requests, and architectural notes for the D.K Home Theatre movie booking app.
